hero.title: Gabon's leading consumer goods distributor and wholesaler since 1989
hero.lead: Cedicom Group proudly stands at the forefront as the premier distributor and wholesaler of Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) in Gabon. Since 1989, we have supplied professionals with integrity and efficiency, and we are preparing our expansion into Angola.

hero.image2_alt: Rice and canned goods racks, forklifts and CEDICOM teams loading a truck in the warehouse
hero.image3_alt: Order pickers and a pallet of boxes between the warehouse racks

about.title: More than 30 years serving trade in Gabon
about.text: Founded in Libreville in 1989, Cedicom Group is today Gabon's leading distributor and wholesaler of consumer goods, and the exclusive representative of several major international brands. The group is preparing its entry into the Angolan market.
